findings.claim: The shaper row of the role table no longer says the shaper writes the Log entry (<date>, shaper) holding its design, and the test assertion for it was removed. The `shaped: L<n>` mark requires exactly one such shaper Log entry, so the instruction that the shaper must write that entry is now stated nowhere in the body. A shaper may then mark tasks with `shaped: L<n>` without writing the entry, and no test catches it.

inceptionReferenceJSONBlock counts only the exact opener "```json\n". A reference using CRLF line endings or "```json " would count as zero blocks (fails loudly, acceptable), but a second block written with a different opener would not be detected as several, so the 'fails on several blocks' guarantee covers only the exact fence spelling.

The role-chain duty list no longer requires the body to contain `candidate`, `inspection.status` or `completed`. The check for them moved to a separate test that reads references/review-record.md. The duty list itself now only requires the pointer, so the exit-2 rule's content is guarded only in the reference file, which the body reaches by a single pointer.

evidence: Read the whole diff; the change moves the exit-2 explanation to a new reference file and registers it in overlay.manifest as custom.
The new JSON-block helper has its own table test covering no block, two blocks and an unclosed block.
The body text of both SKILL.md files still carries the rules the new tests assert (task-line format, prototyper criteria, pointer to review-record.md).
